description: The facade adapter for SYN's booking database. It owns no mail or workflow logic: Conversations still owns the schema and approval semantics, and the original booking unit still receives, drafts and sends. This unit reads that shared domain data into facade-shaped cards and provides the one missing human operation, editing a pending draft. Because it names the same syn-booking database explicitly, it can be replaced without changing the booking engine.

state.statement:
WITH
  inbound_ranked AS (
    SELECT e.*,
           row_number() OVER (
             PARTITION BY e.conversationId
             ORDER BY e.receivedAt DESC, e.sentAt DESC, e.messageId DESC
           ) AS rank
      FROM email e
     WHERE e.direction = 'inbound'
  ),
  latest_inbound AS (
    SELECT * FROM inbound_ranked WHERE rank = 1
  ),
  follow_up_ranked AS (
    SELECT a.*,
           row_number() OVER (
             PARTITION BY a.conversationId
             ORDER BY a.createdAt DESC, a.id DESC
           ) AS rank
      FROM artifact a
     WHERE a.kind = 'follow-up'
       AND a.status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'sent')
  ),
  latest_follow_up AS (
    SELECT * FROM follow_up_ranked WHERE rank = 1
  ),
  cards AS (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN c.state = 'waiting-approval' AND f.id IS NOT NULL THEN f.id
        ELSE c.id
      END AS cardId,
      CASE
        WHEN c.state = 'waiting-approval' AND f.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'review'
        WHEN c.state = 'waiting-reply' THEN 'waiting-reply'
        ELSE 'incoming'
      END AS laneId,
      CASE
        WHEN c.state IN ('waiting-approval', 'waiting-reply') AND f.id IS NOT NULL
          THEN coalesce(nullif(json_extract(f.payload, '$.subject'), ''), c.subject, '(No subject)')
        ELSE coalesce(nullif(c.subject, ''), '(No subject)')
      END AS title,
      CASE
        WHEN c.state IN ('waiting-approval', 'waiting-reply') AND f.id IS NOT NULL
          THEN coalesce(json_extract(f.payload, '$.body'), '')
        ELSE coalesce(i.body, '')
      END AS description,
      c.id AS conversationId,
      f.id AS artifactId,
      c.state AS workflowState,
      f.status AS draftStatus,
      i.sender AS sender,
      i.receivedAt AS receivedAt,
      coalesce(f.updatedAt, c.updatedAt) AS sortTime
    FROM conversation c
    LEFT JOIN latest_inbound i ON i.conversationId = c.id
    LEFT JOIN latest_follow_up f ON f.conversationId = c.id
    WHERE c.state IN (
      'init',
      'needs-follow-up',
      'ready',
      'quotes-requested',
      'waiting-approval',
      'waiting-reply'
    )
  )
SELECT
  cardId,
  laneId,
  title,
  description,
  row_number() OVER (
    PARTITION BY laneId
    ORDER BY sortTime DESC, cardId
  ) - 1 AS position,
  conversationId,
  artifactId,
  workflowState,
  draftStatus,
  sender,
  receivedAt,
  sortTime AS updatedAt
FROM cards
ORDER BY
  CASE laneId
    WHEN 'incoming' THEN 0
    WHEN 'review' THEN 1
    ELSE 2
  END,
  position

UPDATE artifact
   SET payload = json_set(
         CASE WHEN json_valid(payload) THEN payload ELSE '{}' END,
         '$.subject', trim($title),
         '$.body', $description
       ),
       updatedAt = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
 WHERE $operation = 'edit'
   AND id = $cardId
   AND kind = 'follow-up'
   AND status = 'pending'
   AND trim($title) <> ''

items.placeholder: Review generated replies before anything is sent. Edit a draft if needed, then drag it to Waiting for user response to approve it. The card moves only after SMTP delivery succeeds.
